label_coverage.consequence: No human-adjudicated pairs exist, so precision, recall and miss rate below describe the synthetic generator only. They must not be reported as real-world accuracy. Decision D5 is what unblocks a real evaluation.

registration_level.policy: top-1 (one flag per registration, best candidate only)

blocking_projection.assumption: Block sizes come from the generated name/school distribution, not from a real registry. Blocking on surname also selects harder negatives, so the upper bound is the more realistic of the two.

limitations: All labels are synthetic; positives are only repeat_application cases, so recall covers that single duplicate pattern.
Negatives are generated hard negatives (siblings, twins, identifier collisions, common names), not a sample of real applicants.
Registration-level rates come from simulation with independent candidate draws, which understates clustering in a real registry.
No adjudicated (human-reviewed) pair set exists, so precision, recall and miss rate describe this simulator and are not an accuracy claim about real records.
One artifact, one seed. Re-run and diff after any retraining before adopting a replacement model.
